description: This file defines the Message controller class for the Goteo project, providing methods to handle internal messaging, posting comments, and related messaging functionalities within the application.

classes.name: Message
classes.description: Controller class managing user messages, including sending, editing, deleting, and posting comments within the Goteo platform.

methods.name: index
methods.description: Handles creating a new message thread or reply within a project, including notification and feed update logic.

methods.name: edit
methods.description: Allows editing an existing message, marked as deprecated.

methods.name: delete
methods.description: Deletes a message if it belongs to specified project, marked as deprecated.

methods.name: direct
methods.description: Sends an internal message to a project owner or participant, with email notification.

methods.name: personal
methods.description: Sends a personal message to a user, with email notification and authorization check.

methods.name: post
methods.description: Posts a comment on a blog post or project update, including public and admin feed entries, and notifications.
